notes: Spec is unusually explicit: entry pins trigger/direction/filters ('SMA(9) crosses SMA(26) from below to above at the bar close, with the closing price above both averages ... and SMA(26) > SMA(52)'), exits pin both legs ('reverse cross ... or when the price closes below the lower of SMA(26) and SMA(52)'), all params are numeric, and it states 'Stop-loss and take-profit are not used. All signals are confirmed at the bar close.' Prose is generic-asset so the AAPL 1d binding (1507 rows, 2020-2025) is coherent and the 52-bar warm-up fits. The only residual divergence risk is the backtrader realization of 'Position size: 100% of available capital per trade' (order_target_percent(1.0) vs int(cash/close) differ in gap-up order rejections, which would show as missing fills in the primary key), so if the tapes diverge the expected class is unpinned-sizing; same-bar stop-and-reverse collisions are unlikely because the price-vs-cloud exits fire before the reverse cross and D4a's one-position default biases a common if/elif structure.
